[[File:Icon-character-Jedi-Master-Dark.png|40px]]

'''Dark Jedi Master''' is a Dark Side [[Character]] type, shown by the Dark Jedi Master icon in the top left corner of the card. The icon includes a round [[Dark Force]] icon: when you activate Force, each Dark Jedi Master you have in play adds 1 to the Force you generate for yourself. This icon is not tied to any location.<ref name="dcr-djm">[[Decipher Comprehensive Rules#character - Dark Jedi Master|Decipher Comprehensive Rules]], entry “character - Dark Jedi Master” (January 2002 Glossary Supplement).</ref> Dark Jedi Masters also count as Dark Jedi; a Dark Jedi is not a “Jedi”.<ref name="dcr-dj">[[Decipher Comprehensive Rules#character - Dark Jedi|Decipher Comprehensive Rules]], entry “character - Dark Jedi” (January 2002 Glossary Supplement).</ref> It is the Dark Side counterpart of [[Jedi Master]].

Examples: [[Emperor Palpatine]], [[The Emperor]], [[Darth Sidious]], [[Count Dooku]], [[Supreme Leader Snoke]].
